conventions: restriction = binding cap/ban/moratorium/licence non-renewal/registration-with-removal/principal-residence rule; taxes, business-threshold rules, data sharing, standards, fines excluded

enacted = adopted by the competent body between 17 Sep 2026 and 11 Feb 2027, or an already-enacted measure commencing in the window (enumerated: none dated in a >=1% market; residual 0.08); proposals excluded
a freeze extension by new decision counts as enacted anew

gate on the team's GBV/revenue anchors (EU27 share x 0.8): national measures in FR/ES/IT/DE/EL/PT/PL/HR/AT/UK, Paris, London, Canary Islands qualify; Rome borderline (~1.05% of EMEA nights); Athens-only, Ireland, Amsterdam, Lisbon, Madrid, Barcelona, Florence do not

impact.note: modal event = mid-sized enactment, register loss mode 0.10-0.20% of revenue, mostly after Jun 2027 (FY27 half-year weighted -$12M); stock -$0.4 fundamental plus -1% headline term (-$1.7; 0 of 41 moves >=7% regulatory, but 8-9 Sep 2026 proposal window -6.8% vs QQQ -0.4%, shared attribution); level EV -$1.3, surprise EV -$0.8 -> not material on the surprise basis the memo trades; tail (Spanish mass removal or Paris professional ban, P~0.20) -$5/share; quote as one line
